decision: Use release.json with ReleaseIdentity, DistributionChannel, Artifact, ReleaseManifest and one required artifact registry.
reason: One immutable identity spans compiled link and every production executable.
verification: Python unit tests cover malformed identities, exact sets, digest and signature failures.

decision: Use Debian tilde prereleases and macOS development suffixes.
reason: Stable sorts after nightly for the same base version. Full SemVer governs desktop downgrade checks, including date changes.
evidence: Nightly uses the CFBundleVersion development suffix d1. Full SemVer orders nightly dates and sequences in preflight. Native mapping is explicit in ReleaseIdentity.native_versions.
verification: Native ordering is exercised by the Debian acceptance harness. macOS full-version ordering is exercised by preflight tests.

decision: Keep distribution metadata separate from wire ReleaseChannel.
reason: The release milestone does not authorize rolling protocol upgrades.
evidence: Worker protocol 4 and owner protocol 3 remain unchanged.
verification: Source version checks validate protocol mirrors and schema digest.

decision: Require a trust key outside the downloaded release directory.
reason: A bundled replacement key cannot authenticate its own artifacts.
evidence: OpenSSL SHA256 detached signature verification precedes parsing artifact metadata.
verification: A real temporary RSA signature verifies and manifest tampering fails. Fixture files prove validator behavior only.

decision: Verify compiled production entry points before packaging.
reason: Identity output must come from the real binary and compiled link.
evidence: cargo build --workspace --locked; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v; python3 -m unittest discover -s manager/packaging -p test_*.py -v.
verification: PASS: build, clippy, 5 release tests and 19 packaging tests. Workspace tests continue independently.

decision: Build actual Debian packages from fresh staging and a Developer ID signed-capable DMG.
reason: Native replacement preserves external state and established identifiers.
evidence: python3 scripts/release.py build --identity .audit/releases/old.json --target ubuntu24.04-amd64 --output .audit/releases/linux-old --unsigned; repeated with new identity and linux-new output in Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 Docker emulation.
verification: PASS: actual manager and agent Debian archives for 0.1.0-nightly.20261030.1 and 0.1.0-nightly.20261030.2. All embedded identities and native metadata inspected.

decision: Use existing Developer ID Application identity only for reversible local signing.
reason: An installed certificate does not prove notarization or CI key access.
evidence: APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY=Developer ID Application: ADAM KRISTOFFER NILSSON (46BB5R3Y6W); python3 scripts/release.py build --identity .audit/releases/new.json --target macos-arm64 --output .audit/releases/macos-new --unsigned; same old identity build.
verification: PASS: two real DMGs and signed packaged CLI identities. NOT VERIFIED: notarization, Gatekeeper production assessment, and CI certificate access.

decision: Use actual package replacement and state recovery controls.
reason: Package layout or marker copies cannot prove upgrade behavior.
evidence: Docker Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 with SYS_PTRACE, BOTSTRAL_DISPOSABLE_RELEASE_HOST=1, CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/source/target/linux-release: python3 scripts/release_acceptance.py --old .audit/releases/linux-old --new .audit/releases/linux-new --target ubuntu24.04-amd64 --package-only --output .audit/releases/linux-package-acceptance.json
verification: PASS: real upgrades, unmanaged native path refusal, component conflicts, active refusal, downgrade refusal, manager locked restart, actual retained credential use through recorded HTTPS, retained identity/history/artifact/attention/worker records, schema failure and old-backup recovery, worker journal and external bytes, damaged native payload repair. Package-only coverage is explicit.

reason: Ordinary Docker has no systemd PID 1.
verification: NOT VERIFIED: full worker backup/diagnostics and production supervisor. Full harness failed with diagnostic refused: systemd PID 1 required; ordinary OCI containers are unsupported. Native Ubuntu CI runs the full path with systemd 255.

decision: Check actual packaged Mac executable behavior without opening real desktop state.
reason: Signed synthetic Keychain continuity must come from the replaced app.
verification: PASS: distinct executable identities, real DMG replacement, active refusal, interrupted-copy repair, write/read/delete of synthetic Keychain entry through signed old and new packaged executables. Receipt is non-production.

decision: Use maintainer-script arguments and emulator-aware process checks.
reason: dpkg changes database status before preinst, and Rosetta appears as /proc/exe.
evidence: Initial actual package controls exposed downgrade admission and missed active process. The fixed packages use dpkg previous-version arguments and protected command-line paths.
verification: PASS: both actual negative controls refuse after repackaging. Reinstallation reads stored release metadata instead of executing a possibly corrupt installed binary.

reason: Two build identities are not evidence of an upgrade from a previously published revision.
evidence: Local fixture metadata source revision is 6adcbfe2d8d540a5e774356646aecf6515c24d85 with uncommitted implementation files; versions and build identifiers differ.
verification: NOT VERIFIED: historical published-release upgrade and production source provenance of local fixtures. Production build validation allows only generated version mirrors over the pinned revision.

decision: Check source and native output before commit.
reason: Prove It Works and Test Behavior require actual values and failures.
evidence: Python 3.9.6: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v; python3 -m unittest discover -s manager/packaging -p test_*.py -v; cargo fmt --all --check; cargo fmt --manifest-path desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings; cargo test -p botstral-manager --locked --lib offline_restore_reopens; desktop clippy and tests.
verification: PASS: 7 release tests, 19 existing packaging tests, formatting, clippy, existing backup/restore test, desktop tests and builds. Full workspace tests passed earlier; source-only results are not native production acceptance.
